cityHelp: Choose a city, then optionally a neighborhood to narrow your search.
neighborhoodHelp: Optional: choose a neighborhood to narrow results within this city.
chooseCityFirst: Select a city to see its neighborhoods.
emptyCities: The search provider currently has no available cities.
emptyNeighborhoods: No neighborhoods are available for this city. You can search the whole city.
cityUnavailable: The linked city is not in the current provider catalog. Select an available city; we will not silently search another city.
neighborhoodUnavailable: This neighborhood is unavailable for this city or has no valid search ID. Clear it or choose an option from the list.
requestFailed: Could not retrieve locations. Check your connection and retry.
rateLimited: The provider is rate limiting requests. Please wait before retrying.
providerUnavailable: The location provider is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
cityRejected: The provider no longer accepts this city. Refresh cities or select another city.
catalogErrorHelp: Use the retry action in the location fields, or clear the neighborhood to search the whole city when available.
invalidLocationHelp: Choose a city from the current catalog and, optionally, one of its neighborhoods.
draftHelp: Select Search to display results with the current filters.
searchDescription: Choose a city and an optional neighborhood, then set your property filters. Browsing does not require registration.
cityRequired: Choose a city from the provider catalog before searching.
catalogRejected: The cities could not be loaded. Please try again later.
catalogUnavailable: The city catalog endpoint is currently unavailable. Try again later.
neighborhoodRequestFailed: Could not load neighborhoods. Retry, or clear the neighborhood to search the whole city.
cachedCities: Cities could not be refreshed; the last cached catalog is shown.
cachedNeighborhoods: Neighborhoods could not be refreshed; the last cached catalog is shown.
